description: Chambal Fertilisers and Chemicals Limited, together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells fertilizers primarily in India. The company operates through Own Manufactured Fertilisers; Complex Fertilisers; Crop Protection Chemicals and Speciality Nutrients and Seeds; and Others segments. It offers urea; di-ammonium phosphate, muriate of potash, and triple super phosphate; NPK fertilizers; and crop protection chemicals (CPC), speciality nutrients (SN), and agricultural biologicals under the Uttam brand. Chambal Fertilisers and Chemicals Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in New Delhi, India.
